name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px focus ring at 7:1 contrast. It meets WCAG AAA for low vision, ensuring keyboard users see focus clearly without overwhelming the interface. The trade-off is slightly more visual weight, but it’s necessary for users who rely on focus indicators to navigate.

name: Reader
text: The 4px ring at 7:1 contrast fails AAA for users with tunnel vision or cognitive load—they need a *thicker* ring (6px) to *locate* focus, not just see it. A 6px ring at 4.5:1 meets AA for low vision *and* AAA for contrast, while still being usable on high-DPI screens. Test both with real users who have tunnel vision to settle it.
